Implemented and merged as Gerrit change 2131 (commit 9ab5879a95b on main; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, unresolved 0, plain Submit via Rebase-If-Necessary).

Evidence against the acceptance criteria:
- error_code_for(InsecureUrlError(...)) now returns config_insecure_url — InsecureUrlError is classified before the ConfigError arm in src/rebar/_errors.py step 4; RED-first test tests/unit/test_error_code_insecure_url_7d6a.py failed before the fix and passes after (4 passed).
- config_insecure_url added to KNOWN_ERROR_CODES; membership asserted in the same test module.
- Plain ConfigError still classifies as config_unreadable — tests/unit/test_mcp_gate_unreadable_config_errors_8408.py passes, plus contract suites test_mcp_error_envelope_happy.py / test_mcp_error_envelope_heldout.py (30 passed total).
- docs/mcp-reference.md regenerated via python scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py (failure-shape paragraph now documents config_insecure_url); drift gate parity maintained.
- make lint, make typecheck (mypy: no issues in 638 files), and python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check (new=0 increased=0) all passed in the worktree venv.
